response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 5–10 years of C++ development experience on Windows platforms, with most of their experience centered around JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. While they have SQL experience, there is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle proficiency. Their domain expertise does not align with fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking, nor do they demonstrate Summit platform experience or messaging frameworks relevant to the role.
strengths: Strong full-stack development skills in multiple languages and frameworks
Experience with CI/CD, testing methodologies, and dev-ops infrastructure
Proven ability to deliver performance-optimized systems (e.g., low-latency apps, Apple TV app ranking)
concerns: No demonstrated C++ experience on Windows platforms (mandatory skill)
Lacks domain expertise in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking
No SQL Server or Oracle experience mentioned
